svg.title: Stars against GitHub Actions minutes for the most starred repositories
svg.desc: Each of 396 repositories is a dot, with stars on a log axis from 50,000 to 700,000 and minutes on a log axis from 1 to 100 million. The dots form a flat cloud with no visible trend. The Spearman rank correlation is 0.13. PyTorch and openclaw sit far above the rest.
svg.text: 396 repositories with any Actions usage, 30 days. Spearman rank correlation 0.13. 104 repositories with no usage are not shown.
